item.title: Drain on the bend in Cumberland Road blocked with silt and rubbish, now covered in small lake after rainfall, 20th August
item.description:
This drain is blocked with silt and detritus and the rain from a short shower a couple of hours ago is unable to drain away. In addition there is a water leak further up St Mary's Avenue and water from that is running into this same drain. Drains further up both Cumberland Road and St Mary's Avenue are blocked with silt so rainwater runs down the hill over the top of the blocked drains instead of draining into them, ending up in a lake on the bend in Cumberland Road. This problem has been reported before and remains unresolved
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cumberland Road, Shortlands, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
